# View Distance

Measures each element’s world-space distance from a saved or dataset camera.

`lfs.view_distance` · Input

## How to use

Choose a dataset camera, or press Capture view to save the current viewport camera.\
A capture does not follow later viewport movement. The scene must contain dataset cameras.\
Works with splats, point clouds and mesh vertices.

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Distance | `Distance` | lfs.float | — | — | Distance from the chosen camera in world units. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Camera | `camera` | string | 0 | — | Dataset camera index or exact image name; the default 0 selects the first camera. |
| Source | `source` | enum | dataset | dataset; captured | Use a dataset camera or the last captured viewport camera. |
| Captured Transform | `captured_transform` | data | [] | — | Saved camera-to-world matrix, written by Capture view. Empty until captured. |
